note: High findings already applied for some ids — re-read the record; skip anything already correct.

findings.proposed: in-force but being superseded by ADR 79/05 (new models from 1 Dec 2025; all vehicles from 1 Jul 2028)
findings.evidence: Search snippet: "ADR 79/05 ... will apply to newly approved vehicle models supplied on or after 1 December 2025 and all vehicles supplied on or after 1 July 2028." Compared with 79/04 (Euro 5 / UN R83/06).

findings.proposed: superseded (historic compilation; ceased 18 March 2014)
findings.evidence: Body: "No longer in force ... F2012L01123 30 May 2012 - 18 March 2014"; authorised under Motor Vehicle Standards Act 1989 (repealed). Precheck status-text flag confirmed.

findings.current: ADR 00/00 - Approval Procedures and Administrative Requirements / Definitions and Vehicle Categories
findings.proposed: Vehicle Standard (Australian Design Rule - Definitions and Vehicle Categories) 2005 Amendment 6
findings.evidence: Body H1: "Vehicle Standard (Australian Design Rule - Definitions and Vehicle Categories) 2005 Amendment 6". Title adds "Approval Procedures and Administrative Requirements", which is not in the instrument; "00/00" is not in the instrument name.

findings.proposed: UN R134 (hydrogen vehicle safety) / UN GTR 13; R100 is electric power train safety
findings.evidence: Search snippet: ADR 110/00 'designed to align with UN GTR 13 and UN R134'; applies to vehicles with compressed hydrogen storage systems.

findings.proposed: UN R130 (LDWS)
findings.evidence: Search snippet: ADR 99/01 technical requirements incorporate 'United Nations Regulation No. 130 ... Lane Departure Warning Systems ... categories M2, M3, N2 and N3'. UN R157 is ALKS (automated lane keeping), a different system.

findings.current: ...requiring them to meet fleet average CO2, fuel economy, certified emissions, and OBD requirements...
findings.proposed: NVES sets fleet-average CO2 (g/km) targets for suppliers with credits/penalties (from 1 July 2025); it does not itself impose OBD, certified-emissions or fuel-economy limits (those are ADR 79/111/112/81).
findings.evidence: Search snippet: 'a regulatory obligation on car makers to supply vehicles that on average meet a certain CO2 g/km emissions target ... penalties start to apply from 1 July 2025'. Repo body is a generic workbook note listing 'certified emissions, fuel economy, CO2 and OBD' without citing the Act.

findings.proposed: UN R53 (installation of lighting on L3 motorcycles); R48 is for M/N/O categories only
findings.evidence: ADR 19/02 title: "Installation of Lighting and Light Signalling Devices on L-Group Vehicles"; UN R48 scope is categories M, N, O (cf. ADR 13/00 "other than L-Group", which maps to R48). Commodity tags Wiring/Connectors unsupported by body/title.

findings.proposed: in-force only for vehicles first supplied before 1 Oct 2006; superseded by ADR 83/00 for new vehicles
findings.evidence: WebSearch: "ADR 28/01 has been superseded by ADR 83/… for new vehicles as from 1 October 2006." (record has no note of this; ADR 83/00 record au-f2005l03523 is the current new-vehicle standard)

findings.proposed: UN R24 (diesel smoke); drop R83/R168
findings.evidence: WebSearch (dieselnet/transportpolicy): "The smoke standard adopts UN ECE R24/03 and allows the US EPA 98 smoke standards as an alternative." ADR 30/01 is smoke opacity, not R83 pollutant emissions or R168.

findings.proposed: none (static door crush test; FMVSS 214 static is the accepted alternative). UN R95 corresponds to ADR 72/00 dynamic side impact
findings.evidence: WebSearch: ADR 29/00 treats "FMVSS 214-35 ... Side Door Strength - Passenger Cars" S5-S7 as equivalent; "ADR 72/00 is the Australian standard corresponding to UN ECE R95". Record TOC: "DETERMINATION OF CRUSH RESISTANCE".

findings.proposed: UN R137 only
findings.evidence: ADR 69/00 is Full Frontal Impact; UN R94 is the offset deformable barrier regulation (counterpart of ADR 73/00 Offset Frontal Impact, record au-f2005l03990). UN R137 is the full-width frontal regulation.

findings.proposed: UN R21 (interior fittings / instrument panel impact)
findings.evidence: ADR 21/00 Instrument Panel is the occupant-impact standard for the instrument panel; UN R121 covers location/identification of controls, tell-tales and indicators (counterpart of ADR 18/03). Tag "Tell-tales & controls" also questionable.

findings.proposed: UN R80
findings.evidence: ADR 66 covers seat strength/anchorage/padding in omnibuses; UN R80 = "seats of large passenger vehicles ... strength of the seats and their anchorages". R17 is for M1/N seats, not buses.

findings.proposed: UN R18 (historic), UN R116
findings.evidence: UN R162 is vehicle immobilizers, not locks. Search snippet on ADR 25/02: "The UN equivalent for this standard is UNECE Regulation 18 ... Protection Against Unauthorised Use" (R18 superseded by R116).

findings.proposed: UN R56 (headlamps for mopeds)
findings.evidence: UN R56 "approval of headlamps for mopeds and vehicles treated as such"; R112/R113 are asymmetrical/symmetrical passing-beam headlamps for motor vehicles.

findings.proposed: UN R83 only (R83/06 basis)
findings.evidence: UN R168 is "approval of light duty passenger and commercial vehicles with regards to real driving emissions (RDE)", in force 26 Mar 2024; ADR 79/04 adopts UN R83/06 (Euro 5), not R168.

findings.current: "...sets the foundational terminology and vehicle categorization framework that underpins..." (presented as current)
findings.proposed: State that this is a superseded 2012 amendment version, not the current definitions instrument
findings.evidence: Body shows only a one-line TOC ("- [Text]") and "No longer in force"; summary reads as live.

findings.current: covering fitment and visibility of vehicle plates, engine numbers, registration plates, and tray visibility
findings.proposed: Verify against ADR 61/03 text (vehicle identification/compliance plate, VIN marking); registration plates and 'tray visibility' appear unsupported
findings.evidence: Repo body contains only the Federal Register metadata page for 'ADR 61/03 - Vehicle Marking'; no text supports engine numbers, registration plates or tray visibility.

findings.proposed: UN R151 (BSIS for detection of bicycles; ADR 105/00 applies R151 00 series incl. suppl. 1-3)
findings.evidence: Search snippet: 'the technical requirements of UN Regulation No. 151 ... Blind Spot Information System for the Detection of Bicycles ... incorporating the 00 series of amendments' apply under ADR 105/00; R158 is reversing motion, R159 is MOIS.

findings.current: Passenger car, Light truck, Heavy truck, Bus
findings.proposed: Heavy truck (medium/heavy goods vehicles, N2/N3), possibly Bus
findings.evidence: Search snippet: ADR 105/00 applies to medium and heavy goods vehicles (GVM over 8 t, width over 2.5 m), not passenger cars.

findings.current: Passenger car, Light truck, Heavy truck, Bus
findings.proposed: Heavy truck, Bus (M2/M3/N2/N3 heavy vehicles)
findings.evidence: Search snippet: 'New ADR for Lane departure warning systems for all heavy vehicles'; R130 covers M2, M3, N2, N3.

findings.proposed: UN R79 (ELKS/corrective steering function, R79 rev.4 series); not R157 (ALKS)
findings.evidence: Search snippet: ADR 107/00 harmonised with UN R79 revision 4 ('requirements for three control functions relevant to ELKS, including Corrective Steering Function type (c)'). R157 is automated lane keeping.

findings.current: Emissions, On-board diagnostics, Fuel safety, Battery safety, EV charging
findings.proposed: Emissions
findings.evidence: NVES is a fleet CO2 target scheme; no fuel safety, battery safety, charging or OBD requirements. Repo body lists only 'Emissions / CO2 / fleet efficiency' as regulated area.
